function.name: web_search
function.description: Perform a web search on Google with a given keyword or phrase and return the search results.

keyword.description: The keyword or phrase to search.

num_results.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default is 10.

filters.description: The filters to apply, includes 'time_range' (string, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD'), 'language' (string, in the format of ISO 639-1 language code), and 'region' (string, in the format of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code).

function.name: get_search_trends
function.description: Access the search trends on Google.

time_range.description: The time range to get the search trends, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD'. Default is the past 7 days.

location.description: The location to get the search trends, in the format of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Default is not restricted to a specific location and shows global trends.

time_range.description: The time range to get the search history, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD'. Default is the past 7 days.
